project.name: AURA BEAUTY
project.description: Custom headless Shopify storefront — Next.js 14 App Router

app.layout.tsx: Root layout with AnnouncementBar, Header, Navbar, Footer
app.page.tsx: Homepage — hero, featured collections, bestsellers slider

[handle].page.tsx: Collection/category page with sidebar filters + product grid

sale.page.tsx: Sale page — collection page variant with sale filter pre-applied

layout.Header.tsx: Middle header — catalog, logo, search, icons
layout.Navbar.tsx: Navigation bar — category links with active red border

ui.Button.tsx: Reusable button — outline and filled variants
ui.PriceDisplay.tsx: Current price + struck-through original if on sale

product.ProductCard.tsx: Product card with image, badges, name, price, CTA
product.ProductInfo.tsx: PDP title, price, variants, add-to-cart section

filters.FilterSidebar.tsx: 240px sidebar — price, brand, volume, country filters

lib.shopify.ts: Storefront API client — fetch wrapper with auth headers
lib.types.ts: TypeScript interfaces for Shopify data shapes
lib.utils.ts: Price formatting, handle slugify, badge logic helpers

public.logo.svg: AURA BEAUTY logo SVG with red underline flourish

tree.tailwind.config.ts: Tailwind config with design token extensions
tree.next.config.ts: Next.js config — image domains for Shopify CDN

routes.description: Sale items — collection page with sale tag filter
Bestsellers — collection with bestseller tag filter

AnnouncementBar.description: Full-width strip, bg #111, white text. Phone numbers centered. Social icon links right-aligned (Instagram, Facebook, Viber, WhatsApp, Telegram, TikTok).

Header.description: Three-column header. Left: hamburger catalog menu button. Center: AURA BEAUTY text logo with red SVG underline flourish. Right: search bar input + account icon + wishlist heart icon (badge count) + cart bag icon (badge count).

Navbar.description: White bg horizontal nav. Links: SALES, BESTSELLERS, BRANDS, FACE CARE, HAIR CARE, BODY CARE, HOME PRODUCTS. Active link has red left border indicator. 13px uppercase letter-spacing.

Footer.description: Dark #1A1A1A bg. 4 columns: 1) Contact — phone, address, hours. 2) Categories list. 3) Brands list. 4) Info links + social icons row. White text throughout.

ProductCard.description: White bg card, 80px padding, hover shadow. Square image area (object-fit: contain). Badge overlays top-left. Category tag 11px gray. Product name 14px 2-line clamp. PriceDisplay component. Full-width ADD TO CART button (outline hover fill).

ProductGrid.description: CSS grid 4 columns (responsive: 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile). Maps products to ProductCard.

Badge.description: NEW: dark navy #1B1F3B pill. BESTSELLER: beige #C9B99A pill with 'BEAUTY BOX' sub-label. Sale: red #C8102E circle with percent value.

PriceDisplay.description: Shows price 16px bold. If compareAtPrice exists and is higher, shows original price struck-through in gray, sale price in red.

FilterSidebar.description: 240px fixed sidebar, #F7F7F7 bg. Contains PriceRangeFilter, BrandFilter, VolumeFilter, CountryFilter. Each section has collapsible header.

BrandFilter.description: Scrollable list (max-height 200px overflow-y auto) with checkboxes.

CountryFilter.description: Options: USA, France, Korea, Japan, Israel, Ukraine, Germany, Italy, UK

Pagination.description: Numbered pagination. Shows up to 7 page numbers with ellipsis. Prev/Next arrows.

SortDropdown.description: Options: Featured, Price Low to High, Price High to Low, Newest, Best Selling

BrandsAlphabetical.description: Groups brands by first character (0-9, A-Z). Each section has letter heading. Featured brands show red checkmark. Expandable about text at bottom.

PromoBanner.description: Full-width pink/salmon #F9E4E4 bg banner. Gift certificate advertisement. Static content.

PopularProductsSlider.description: Horizontal scrollable 5-card product slider. Section title 'Popular Products'. Prev/next arrows.

CartDrawer.description: Slide-in from right. Uses hydrogen-react useCart. Lists CartItem components. Shows CartSummary at bottom.

CartSummary.description: Subtotal display + Checkout button linking to Shopify checkout URL.

AddToCartButton.description: Uses hydrogen-react useCart.linesAdd. White bg black border outline, hover: black bg white text.

GET_PRODUCTS_BY_COLLECTION.description: Fetch products for a collection with cursor-based pagination, sort key, and filters

GET_ALL_COLLECTIONS.description: Fetch all collections for navbar and footer

GET_ALL_VENDORS.description: Fetch all unique product vendors for brands page and brand filter
GET_ALL_VENDORS.note: Deduplicate vendor strings client-side and sort alphabetically. For brand metaobjects, use Admin API or metaobjects query.

SEARCH_PRODUCTS.description: Predictive search and full search results

PREDICTIVE_SEARCH.description: Live search suggestions as user types

CollectionFilter.label: string
CollectionFilter.values: { id: string; label: string; count: number; input: string }[]

CollectionPage.dataFetching: Server Component — fetch collection + products via GET_PRODUCTS_BY_COLLECTION
CollectionPage.layout: Breadcrumbs -> H1 title -> [FilterSidebar (240px) | [SortDropdown + ProductGrid + Pagination]] -> PromoBanner -> PopularProductsSlider

filterMapping.price: ProductFilter: { price: { min: number, max: number } }
filterMapping.country: ProductFilter: { productMetafield: { namespace: 'custom', key: 'country_of_origin', value: string } }

SalePage.description: Reuses CollectionPage layout. Pre-applies filter: tag = 'sale'. All products show red % badge.

BestsellersPage.description: Reuses CollectionPage layout. Pre-applies filter: tag = 'bestseller'. All products show BESTSELLER badge.

BrandsPage.dataFetching: Server Component — fetch all vendors via GET_ALL_VENDORS, deduplicate, sort A-Z
BrandsPage.layout: Breadcrumbs -> H1 'Brands' -> BrandsAlphabetical -> expandable about section

ProductDetailPage.layout: Breadcrumbs -> [ProductGallery | ProductInfo] -> Description -> Related Products slider

HomePage.dataFetching: Server Component — fetch featured collection + bestsellers
HomePage.layout: HeroBanner -> Featured Collections grid -> Bestsellers slider -> Brands logos strip -> PromoBanner

clientSetup.pattern: async function shopifyFetch<T>({ query, variables }: { query: string; variables?: Record<string, unknown> }): Promise<T> — wraps fetch(), throws on non-200, returns data field

filterUrlStrategy.description: All filters live as URL search params. FilterSidebar reads from searchParams and calls router.push() with updated params. This enables shareable filtered URLs and server-side rendering of filtered results.

paginationStrategy.description: Shopify Storefront API uses cursor-based pagination. Maintain a page->cursor map in the URL or server state. For page N, store cursors array from previous fetches. Simple approach: use 'after' cursor param directly in URL.
paginationStrategy.implementation: Each page fetch returns endCursor. Store as ?cursor=xxx in URL. Pagination component shows numbered pages by pre-fetching total count or estimating from collection product count metafield.

accessibilityNotes.focusRing: All interactive elements have visible focus ring (outline-2 outline-offset-2)
accessibilityNotes.altText: All product images use product title + variant as alt text
accessibilityNotes.ariaLabels: Cart button: 'Shopping cart, {n} items'. Wishlist: 'Wishlist'. FilterSidebar sections use role=group with legend.
accessibilityNotes.skipNav: Skip to main content link as first focusable element
